title: Hell Mode Anime Gets 3rd Season for 'S-Rank Dungeon Conquest Arc'
content:
The official website for the television anime of writer Hamuo and illustrator Mo 's Hell Mode - The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing ( Hell Mode - Yarikomi Suki no Gamer wa Hai Settei no Isekai de Musō Suru ) light novel series announced on Saturday that the anime is getting a third season for the "S-Kyū Dungeon Kо̄ryaku-hen" ("S-Rank Dungeon Conquest Arc"). The website unveiled a visual:

The second season ended on Friday (effectively, Saturday).

Masato Tamagawa ( Saint Seiya: Saintia Shō , The Genius Prince's Guide to Raising a Nation Out of Debt , The Great Cleric ) returned to direct the new season at Yokohama Animation Lab . Daishiro Tanimura ( Magical Destroyers ) was also back in charge of the series scripts. Kei Tsushima ( The Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These ) designed the characters again. Misaki Tsuchida , Junko Nakajima , Reiko Abe , Moyu Kanazaki , Kaho Sawada , Kanade Sakuma , BeauDamian , and Tsugumi Tanaka all composed the music again, alongside Shūichirō Fukuhiro , Mayo Kurihara , and Shin Miki .

The series debuted on the Tokyo MX channel on July 3 at 25:00 (effectively, July 4 at 1:00 a.m.), and it is also running on MBS , BS NTV , and AT-X . HIDIVE is streaming the anime as it airs in Japan.

The anime's first season debuted on television on January 9 at 25:05 (effectively January 10 at 1:05 a.m.), before airing later that night on MBS . The anime then aired on BS NTV on January 11 at 12:00 a.m.). The anime debuted on ABEMA and d Anime Store on January 9 at 25:35 (effectively January 10 at 1:35 a.m.). The anime then debuted streaming on U-NEXT and Anime Hōdai on January 12. HIDIVE streamed the anime as it aired, and it is also streaming an English dub .

Hamuo launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in November 2019, and the story is ongoing. Earth Star Entertainment began publishing the series in print in July 2020.

Tetta launched the ongoing manga on Comic Earth Star in October 2020.
author: ANN

title: Dentsu Enters Partnership with Kodansha
content:
Variety reported on Friday that major Japanese advertising firm Dentsu is entering a partnership with Kodansha Ltd. that will give potential clients in North and South America access to several Kodansha intellectual properties (IPs) including Attack on Titan , Ghost in the Shell , and Blue Lock . The partnership makes Dentsu the central point of contact for brand marketers looking for sponsorships, tie-in campaigns, live events, and fan experiences related to the IPs.

Kodansha 's popular manga titles include Attack on Titan , Akira, Blue Lock , Cells at Work! , Tokyo Revengers , Initial D , and That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime (which itself adapts a light novel series).

Kodansha announced in November 2025 that it had established Kodansha Studios in Hollywood with award-winning Chinese director Chloé Zhao ( Nomadland ) and film producer Nicolas Gonda. The company won a lawsuit against American internet infrastructure company Cloudflare in the same month that it had filed along with several other Japanese publishing companies. The company launched its manga distribution service K manga in May 2023.

Dentsu was founded in 1901 in Tokyo. The company is now active in 120 countries and territories. It established a new company called Dentsu Anime Solutions in July 2023. As a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Dentsu Group under Dentsu Japan, the company focuses on selling and licensing anime to broadcasters and distributors locally and overseas.

title: Scotland Loves Anime 2026 Details "Coming Soon"
content:
The Scotland Loves Anime festival has posted the following message on its X/Twitter feed:

"We know you're chomping at the bit to get your hands on the line-up for this year's festival, so this is just a quick update to shyly say it's coming very soon - we're finalising details to launch everything over the next couple of weeks. Stay tuned!"

Scotland Loves Anime had previously announced in February that the event would return in 2026, running at the Glasgow Film Theatre in November 6 to 8, and then at the Edinburgh Filmhouse from November 16 to 22. According to the February announcement, the festival would also come to London, with the date and venue details TBC. The same dates and venues are given on the lovesanimation.com website as of writing.

The festival began in 2010, running annually until 2019. During the Covid pandemic, there was an online festival in 2021, and the festival returned in full in 2022. 2024 was the first year in which the festival had a run in London.

The most recent festival was from October to November 2025, including screenings of All You Need Is Kill , Lupin the IIIrd: The Immortal Bloodline , ChaO , The Last Blossom and 100 Meters . Guests at the event included Takeshi Koike (the director of Redline and Lupin the IIIrd: The Immortal Bloodline ), Kenichiro Akimoto (the director of All You Need Is Kill ) and Yasuhiro Aoki (the director of ChaO ).

Source : Scotland Loves Anime X/Twitter feed

title: One Piece Anime's First 325 Episodes Stream on Crunchyroll in India
content:
Crunchyroll began streaming the anime's Elbaph arc in India on April 5. The Elbaph arc debuted in Japan on April 5. Netflix is streaming the arc in India as well. Crunchyroll will stream the English dub of the arc (from episode 1156) in India beginning on October 20.

Toei Animation and One Piece anime producer Ryūta Koike announced on October 28 that the main anime is reducing its annual episode output to a maximum of 26 episodes moving forward starting in 2026. Following the conclusion of the Egghead arc last year, the anime took a three-month production hiatus from January-March 2026. The anime returned in April 2026 for the first of two cours (quarters of a year) with the start of the new Elbaph arc.

According to Toei Animation , the new schedule allows episodes to "incorporate more content, tempo, and pacing of the manga while continuing to leverage the unique storytelling that is only possible with animation." Historically, with only few exceptions, the anime has aired most weeks since its premiere in 1999. However, the pace has slowed considerably over the years.

The Egghead arc in the anime debuted in January 2024 and Crunchyroll began streaming it in India in April 2024. Crunchyroll added episodes 892-1077 of the anime in India in September 2023 and began streaming episode 1078 onwards from October 2023. It began streaming the English dub of episodes 1144–1155 from the Egghead arc on March 24. Crunchyroll added the Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu dubs of the Egghead arc on March 30.

The ongoing anime adaptation of Eiichiro Oda 's One Piece manga premiered in 1999.

Netflix added the 2014 special edition of the 2008 One Piece: Episode of Chopper + Fuyu ni Saku, Kiseki no Sakura anime film, the One Piece: Strong World anime film, and the One Piece Film Z anime in India in early 2024. The streaming service added the One Piece Film Gold anime movie in India in January 2024. It added the One Piece Film Red anime in India in December 2023. The film opened in India in October 2022.

Voice actors Kappei Yamaguchi (voice of Usopp) and Hiroaki Hirata (voice of Sanji) attended Mumbai Comic Con as part of the anime's cast in April 2025.

title: 'Hell Mode' Third Season in Production
content:
• The 13th and final episode of Hell Mode: Yarikomizuki no Gamer wa Hai Settei no Isekai de Musou suru 2nd Season ( Hell Mode: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing Season 2 ) ended with an announcement on Friday that a third season is in production. The official website also revealed an announcement visual (pictured).

Produced by Yokohama Animation Lab , the first season aired in 12 episodes in Winter 2026. The second season premiered on July 4. Sentai Filmworks licensed the anime, with HIDIVE simulcasting the series with multiple subtitles.

The anime series adapts Hamuo 's adventure fantasy light novel , which began on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in November 2019. Earth Star Entertainment acquired the novel under its Earth Star Novel imprint in July 2020, featuring illustrations by Mo . The 14th volume went on sale on July 15.

Enji Tetta began drawing a manga adaptation on the Comic Earth☆Star web magazine in October 2020. The 14th volume was released on July 10.

J-Novel Club licensed both the light novel and manga in English in July 2021 and July 2023, respectively. The 12th light novel volume went on sale on August 5. The 11th manga volume was released on September 2.

title: 'Kore Kaite Shine' Gets Second Season
content:
The 12th and final episode of Kore Kaite Shine ( Draw This, Then Die! ) ended with an announcement on Saturday that a second season is in production. The official website also revealed an announcement visual (pictured right).

Produced by Shin-Ei Animation , the television anime adapting Minoru Toyoda 's comedy drama manga began airing on July 3. Crunchyroll simulcasted the anime in English subtitles and dubs.

Toyoda began serializing the manga in Gessan magazine in November 2021. Shogakukan published the tenth volume on July 10.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga in English on October 22 last year and released the first volume on August 11. The second volume is scheduled to release on November 3.

Kore Kaite Shine won the 16th Manga Taisho Awards in 2023 and the 70th Shogakukan Manga Awards in January 2025 alongside Shakunetsu Kabaddi ( Burning Kabaddi ), Natsume Arata no Kekkon ( Arata Natsume Getting Married ), and Puniru wa Kawaii Slime . The manga also placed sixth in the 2023 edition of the Kono Manga ga Sugoi! rankings in the Male Readers category.

Synopsis Ai Yasumi, a first-year high school student living on Izu-Oshima, loves manga more than anything. When she learns that her long-admired, yet long-inactive, favorite manga artist Hoshi no Rei will be exhibiting at COMITIA, she sets off on a journey to Tokyo.

What she doesn't expect, however, is that a fateful encounter at the event will change her life forever.

"How does one become a manga artist?" Ai steps into the world of manga creation—a path she thought she understood, yet knows so little about. This is the story of a girl taking her first steps down the road to becoming a mangaka.

title: Please Excuse My Younger Brothers TV Anime Reveals More Cast, New Ending Theme
content:
The staff for the television anime adaptation of Akira Ozaki 's Please Excuse My Younger Brothers ( Uchi no Otōto-domo ga Sumimasen ) manga revealed the third promotional video and a second key visual on Friday for the show's second cours (quarter of a year). The second cours will start on October 2.

The above video previews both the opening and ending theme songs. Neguse. performs the new opening theme song "LOVE & LIKE," and MEminor performs the ending theme song "Mabataki."

Yōko Hikasa joins the cast as Azusa Yashiro.

The anime debuted on July 3 on Tokyo MX , Gunma TV , Tochigi TV , and BS11 at 24:00 JST (effectively July 4 at 12 midnight JST), and will air for two consecutive cours . The anime will have a total of 24 episodes. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as it airs.

The anime stars:

• Naomi Ōzora as Ito Narita

• Toshiki Masuda as Gen Narita

• Taku Yashiro as Raku Narita

• Kenshō Ono as Syu Narita

• Momoka Terasawa as Rui Narita

• Daisuke Ono as Isao Narita

• Aya Endō as Saho Narita

Hitoshi Nanba ( Golden Kamuy ) is directing the anime at Lay-duce . Megumi Shimizu ( My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! ) is handling series composition. Shiori Hiraiwa ( Tomo-chan Is a Girl! ) and Yōko Fukushima ( #COMPASS2.0 ANIMATION PROJECT ) are designing the characters. Gin of Busted Rose ( Pop Team Epic ; Don't Toy with Me, Miss Nagatoro ) is composing the music.

Additional staff members are:

• Art Design: Chie Okubo

• Prop Design: Takashi Akaishizawa

• Color Design: Tomoko Yamazaki

• Director of Photography: Naoki Ishikawa

• Editing: Gō Sadamatsu

• Sound Director: Satoshi Motoyama

• Sound Production: INSPION Edge

DISH// performs the current opening theme song "Aikotoba" and Reira Ushio performs the current ending theme song "Clover."

The manga centers on high school student Ito Hazui. During her spring break at the end of her first year of high school, Ito's mother remarries, and Ito moves to live with her new family, becoming Ito Narita. Upon arriving at her new house, Ito is shocked to learn she now has four younger step-brothers. Ito tries her hardest to get along with all of the new members of her family, but the eldest brother Gen is a bit cold to her. However, under his aloof facade, he occasionally shows his kindness.

Ozaki debuted the manga in Shueisha 's Bessatsu Margaret magazine in January 2020. Shueisha published the manga's 15th compiled book volume on June 25.

contentBlocks.text: The staff for the television anime adaptation of Akira Ozaki 's Please Excuse My Younger Brothers ( Uchi no Otōto-domo ga Sumimasen ) manga revealed the third promotional video and a second key visual on Friday for the show's second cours (quarter of a year). The second cours will start on October 2.
The above video previews both the opening and ending theme songs. Neguse. performs the new opening theme song "LOVE & LIKE," and MEminor performs the ending theme song "Mabataki."
Yōko Hikasa joins the cast as Azusa Yashiro.

contentBlocks.credit: Image via Uchi no Otōto-domo ga Sumimasen anime's X/Twitter account

contentBlocks.text: The anime debuted on July 3 on Tokyo MX , Gunma TV , Tochigi TV , and BS11 at 24:00 JST (effectively July 4 at 12 midnight JST), and will air for two consecutive cours . The anime will have a total of 24 episodes. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as it airs.
The anime stars:
Naomi Ōzora as Ito Narita
Toshiki Masuda as Gen Narita
Taku Yashiro as Raku Narita
Kenshō Ono as Syu Narita
Momoka Terasawa as Rui Narita
Daisuke Ono as Isao Narita
Aya Endō as Saho Narita

Hitoshi Nanba ( Golden Kamuy ) is directing the anime at Lay-duce . Megumi Shimizu ( My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! ) is handling series composition. Shiori Hiraiwa ( Tomo-chan Is a Girl! ) and Yōko Fukushima ( #COMPASS2.0 ANIMATION PROJECT ) are designing the characters. Gin of Busted Rose ( Pop Team Epic ; Don't Toy with Me, Miss Nagatoro ) is composing the music.
Additional staff members are:
Art Design: Chie Okubo
Prop Design: Takashi Akaishizawa
Color Design: Tomoko Yamazaki
Director of Photography: Naoki Ishikawa
Editing: Gō Sadamatsu
Sound Director: Satoshi Motoyama
Sound Production: INSPION Edge
DISH// performs the current opening theme song "Aikotoba" and Reira Ushio performs the current ending theme song "Clover."

The manga centers on high school student Ito Hazui. During her spring break at the end of her first year of high school, Ito's mother remarries, and Ito moves to live with her new family, becoming Ito Narita. Upon arriving at her new house, Ito is shocked to learn she now has four younger step-brothers. Ito tries her hardest to get along with all of the new members of her family, but the eldest brother Gen is a bit cold to her. However, under his aloof facade, he occasionally shows his kindness.
Ozaki debuted the manga in Shueisha 's Bessatsu Margaret magazine in January 2020. Shueisha published the manga's 15th compiled book volume on June 25.
The manga inspired a live-action film adaptation that opened in Japan in December 2024. The film debuted at #4 in its opening weekend.
